summary: QuickType readability and bounded backspace recovery

changes.title: Stable deletion, guaranteed recovery
changes.detail: Retain the 185 ms rapid-delete display-only hold; refresh the current prefix even if unchanged and discard an inert row after the additional 120 ms grace if no valid result arrives. Cancel held presentation at editor, privacy, cursor and swipe boundaries; repeated empty predictions cannot renew the same clear deadline.

changes.title: Scale Improved readability and continuity
changes.detail: Keep the original Scale preset unchanged. Refine Improved glyph entry and exit size, reduce compression, give compatible arriving letters earlier readability, and coordinate confidence chrome over 85 ms. When a provisional frame is replaced before it draws, retarget from the previous presented ink rather than the unseen intermediate.

changes.title: Safer provisional suggestions
changes.detail: Exclude expiring correction recall and application-defined entries from prefix previews. Preserve native decoder ranking, autocorrection decisions, touch routing and the prior privacy cleanup. Add regression tests for the recovery state, preset contracts and preview exclusions.
